explanation: erdosproblems.com/649: RMM 2020 Problem 6: there are infinitely many odd primes p such that P(n)P(n+1) ≠ 2p for every n. The Lean statement: {p | p prime ∧ Odd p ∧ ∀ n, maxPrimeFac n · maxPrimeFac (n+1) ≠ 2p} is infinite. Including n = 0 is harmless (the product there involves P(0) or P(1), which are not 2 and p). Faithful.
